raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
JPMorgan Chase & Co. – Senior Team Member, November 2022 – Present
Current process – Hedge Fund Accounting Fund Accounting (NAV)
Managed Monthly NAV production across hedge funds, validated P&L, accruals and oversaw investor
allocations.
Performed trade settlements for equities, Fixed income, FX, Swap.
Reconciled prime broker’s, custodian’s position/cash/FX investigated and cleared exceptions.
Handle Bank loan events including paydowns, drawdowns, interest and realized/unrealized PNL.
Monitored and reconciled collateral, financing (swap financing, accruals, coupons, notionals, Resets).
Reviewed valuation/pricing controls as per admin procedures.
Preparation of annual fee budgets at the beginning of the year involves the accumulation of monthly
financial accruals, which encompass both management and performance fees.
Calculated and reviewed management fee, performance fees/incentive allocations.
Oversaw Capital activity processing (subscriptions, redemptions, transfers and ensure investor level allocations
Supported month – end/quarter -end /Annual closures. Maintained books and executed period end close in
Geneva, NAV support packages.
Analyzed P&L drivers (market vs trade, costs).
Enhanced controls and procedures, maker checker reviews.
Automated reconciliations and reports using Excel (Pivots, Alteryx) by improving time and reduced manual
work.
• Awarded in recognition of outstanding performance and commitment to excellence during Q3,2024.
BNP Paribas – Associate Levl 1, March 2020 – November 2022
Reviewed daily, weekly and monthly NAV funds/portfolios in accordance with applicable Industry recommended accounting practices, accounting standard or specific constitutional documents.
Worked with fund/portfolio accountants and liaise with different support functions to ensure NAVs are delivered in timely manner to meet the agreed KPIs. Ensure NAV calculations are accurately prepared and in line with the operational and system procedural manual.
Performed of NAV Calculation including – Reconciliations of Cash, Security Positions & TA, processing of Corporate Actions & Dividends, Setting up of expense Accruals for funds, processing of trades which includes Equity, Bonds, Derivatives(Futures), Private securities.
Reconciled daily trade transactions to ascertain necessary month-end adjustment measures for the monthly NAV
funds.
Responsible and track the status of Daily NAV deliverables and to perform the daily rollover activities after the completion of the funds.
Performed a high level review of huge variations in market values of the securities, corporate actions, incomes, expenses, trades, share/cash breaks, to ensure accuracy.
Assisted the manager in the allocation of the team’s various month end activities and ensuring the
completion of the tasks before the client’s deadline.
Awarded forbeing proactive in critical peak hours – SPOTAward ~March 2022
Statestreet HCL Services – Analyst June 2017 – June 2019
Performingvarious Reconciliations activitiesi.e. Cash Recons, PositionRecons with Backups for ageing breaks
with sources like mail, websites, Fund houses and other teams.
Booking allactivities in Mutual fund accounting Database such as Cash Payments and Receipts, Dividends, Wire
Payments and Receipts, accounting related transactions and Fund Transfers.
Ensuring accuracy of Funds by processingandreviewing Trades, Cash Transactions, reinvestments, securities,
Fund, CUSIP, Shares, Price and Market Valuewith the monthly statements and client confirmations.
Pricing, validatingand preparingMonthly reports(for Prior Month) with appropriate backups to produce NAV.
Performing Quarterly reporting on a quarterly basis and Annual reporting as per the year end
requirement
Subscription/Redemption/Re-investments/Management Fees for MF securities as per the
statements.

Identifying exceptions and problems affecting accounting records and prices, communicating same to
management, and assisting in their resolution.
NAV change will be validated, Backed-up and approved in-case of tolerance breach.
Awarded twice the Best Team Award for Q3 2018 and Q1 2019.
Additional Responsibilities
Supported year-end audits by resolving queries and providing accurate data.
Trained new team members on fund structures and processes.
Handled an ad-hoc requests and maintained SOPs documentation.
Ensured accuracy, deadline in deliverables and timely response to mails.
